name: AdvancedEncryption.WE.Reroute.kilian_partition_iff
title: Invertible re-randomization cannot change a comparator state partition
statement: Over a field, if an invertible T maps the indicator row of state kA x to the indicator row of state kB x for every prefix x, then kA x = kA y iff kB x = kB y for all prefixes x, y.
